# Parikshio

> Free live exam software for schools, colleges, universities and coaching institutes.

Parikshio (https://www.parikshio.tech) lets an institute run an online exam in the browser. Faculty push questions with a server-synced timer — one at a time or a whole paper at once. Students join with a short code on any phone, tablet or laptop. Answers auto-grade as they arrive. Written answers can be scored with AI. Papers can be uploaded with OCR. Google Classroom sync, a live leaderboard, analytics and CSV export are included. Nothing to install.

## Who it is for

- Schools: classroom quizzes, nothing to install
- Colleges and universities: lecture-hall assessments, one join code
- Coaching and training institutes: timed mock tests and practice papers

## Product facts

- 5 question formats
- 2 exam modes (live push and self-paced)
- Server clock for every student
- Instant auto-grading and AI evaluation for written answers
- Offline-safe answer save
- Paper upload with OCR
- Google Classroom roster matching
